rulesTestNames: lets managers list an event's help-request and delivery views
owner: Host event case view evaluator: hostReadModels event case view triggers
read: current organizer managers list an event's views for one status (organizerId, eventId and status, ordered by document id); authority comes from the organizer document
write: server only; one view per live case owned by the event lead, deleted when the case is missing, safety-owned or rehearsal, or its organizer or event is gone
migrationNotes: view is the row the retired listEventAssistanceCases callable returned; the handoff choices are built on the phone from the organizer document.
sourceCoverage invalidSource keeps the previous view and names incompleteSource; the phone fails the page rather than hiding a request.
